SELECT FROM ai_inspect_library WHERE deleted = 0
AND business_expected = #{businessExpected}
AND (template LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR headline LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR match_value LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY business_expected ASC, hit_count DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, match_type, match_value, template, business_expected, headline, reason, operator, hit_count, last_hit_time, first_seen_time, enabled, create_time, update_time FROM ai_inspect_library
ORDER BY business_expected ASC, hit_count DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_inspect_library (match_type, match_value, template, pattern, business_expected, sample_message, headline, reason, operator, first_seen_time, enabled) VALUES (#{matchType}, #{matchValue}, #{template}, #{pattern}, #{businessExpected}, #{sampleMessage}, #{headline}, #{reason}, #{operator}, #{firstSeenTime}, 1)

INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_inspect_library (match_type, match_value, template, pattern, business_expected, sample_message, headline, reason, operator, first_seen_time, enabled) VALUES
(#{it.matchType}, #{it.matchValue}, #{it.template}, #{it.pattern}, #{it.businessExpected}, #{it.sampleMessage}, #{it.headline}, #{it.reason}, #{it.operator}, #{it.firstSeenTime}, 1)
